dek: Senator Chris Van Hollen called for the war on Iran to end, writing: 'Trump's illegal Iran war is turning into our next forever war. Eight months in, Trump and Republicans have deluded themselves into thinking the next strike or another bombing campaign will finally bring victory.
sources: Senator Chris Van Hollen X post, carried by Al Jazeera liveblog 03:40 GMT Oct 25
fault_line: Forever war or unfinished job -- does another strike campaign end the threat, or repeat Vietnam-to-Iraq?

sections.what_happened: Senator Chris Van Hollen called for the war on Iran to end, writing: 'Trump's illegal Iran war is turning into our next forever war. Eight months in, Trump and Republicans have deluded themselves into thinking the next strike or another bombing campaign will finally bring victory. From Vietnam to Iraq, we know how this ends. This war must end NOW.' He shared an article on US-Israeli plans to renew attacks on Iran after the US midterm elections.
